overview_description.description:
Pulse Q&A is an internet company that empowers CIOs to make innovation and spend decisions based on crowdsourced data. The company gives its users access to relevant conversations and data, they can now make decisions that actually move the needle.

Pulse Q&A was founded in 2017 and headquartered in California, United States.
